name: Inn by the Sea
positioning: Oceanfront beach resort on Crescent Beach in Cape Elizabeth, Maine, a short drive from downtown Portland
best_for: Couples and families wanting a Maine beach stay with a spa
Guests who care about sustainability and nature programs

facts.text: Inn by the Sea is located on a mile of sandy beach on the coast of Maine.
The inn is in Cape Elizabeth, about a 15-minute drive from downtown Portland, Maine.
Guestrooms and one- or two-bedroom suites have private exterior entrances.
The spa offers massages, facials and body treatments, with private relaxation sanctuaries, steam rooms and experience showers.
The resort has an outdoor swimming pool and private cabanas.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes and on-demand fitness classes.
All of the property's clean electricity comes from solar, and there are composting programs for guests.
The inn runs environmental programs and long-term commitments to restore the surrounding land, with green design throughout.
On property there are weekly Beach Ecology Walks, Garden Tours and Great Pond Walks.
Sea Glass, the restaurant, uses ingredients from Maine farms and fishermen.
The inn partners with BabyQuip so families can rent baby gear.

highlights.text: Crescent Beach, a salt-water beach with relatively warm water, is reached from the inn by a private boardwalk.
Garden suites and loft suites in the main house often have two floors, Atlantic views, private decks and kitchenettes.
Beach suites can have views of Crescent Beach, a private outdoor patio, a fully equipped kitchen, a gas fireplace, a steam shower and an extra-large bathtub.
Spa treatments use marine-based skincare products with seaweed extracts and marine peptides.
Daily morning yoga is a mixed-level class for adults, overlooking the Atlantic.

considerations.text: Spa services and amenities are reserved for guests 18 and older; the minimum age for services is 16 when accompanied by an adult.
Advance reservations are required for all spa services.
WhataHotel notes a remote coastal location that requires transportation for activities, and seasonal weather limits on outdoor activities.
